== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and [[Bowcaster (Errata)]] articles. Columns are Original and Decipher Errata (Glossary 2.0) only. Appendix A p. 106 matches Glossary 2.0, so there is no PC Errata column. Do not add Revised, Japanese, foil, or (V) columns. Do not mix [[Bowcaster (V)]]. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
